report.scene: A hand holds a white ROMOSS power bank with a round digital display showing 31% and a large outlined 20+ graphic on the front, against a striped fabric background.

matching_details: It is a power bank, the same kind of product as the recall.
A large 20 appears on the lower front, loosely like the 20W print on the recalled unit.
differing_details: The body is white, while the recalled power bank is black.
The brand ROMOSS is printed in the middle of the front; the recall is for HAIARA.
There is a round black digital display showing 31% near the top; the official images show no display.
The 20+ graphic is a large outline design in the lower right, not the small 20W text centered at the bottom.
The shape is longer and narrower than the recalled unit, and there is no magnetic ring marking.
No Model: W5 PRO text is visible.
product.reason_plain: No. This is a white ROMOSS power bank, not the black HAIARA W5 PRO in the recall.
product.reason_technical: Different brand (ROMOSS logo), different color (white vs black), a digital percentage display, different 20+ graphic and proportions. Same product category only, so the score is well under 0.6.

actions.evidence: No handwritten or marker writing is visible anywhere on the front of the power bank. Only printed ROMOSS and 20+ graphics and the lit display are seen.

photo_source.reason: A real hand holds the device with natural lighting, shadows and a fabric background; no screen, printout or digital image signs are visible.

report.retake_tip: This looks like a different power bank, so please check that you have the black HAIARA W5 PRO, write recalled on it in marker, and photograph the whole unit with the side label showing.
